co-founding-ceo-portfolio-startup-hormon.h2: Co-founding CEO (Portfolio Startup, Hormonal Precision Diagnostics)
co-founding-ceo-portfolio-startup-hormon.jlDesc:
EU/US | 20-30% founding equity | Founder-level salary after the angel round

We are building a stealth-stage precision-diagnostics startup at the intersection of women’s health and autoimmunity, focused on one of the most consequential gaps in modern treatment. We already know autoimmunity has a hormonal component: women develop these diseases far more often, and disease activity shifts with pregnancy, postpartum, menopause and other hormonal transitions. So why do almost all autoimmune treatment regimens address only the immune system?

We are developing a new diagnostic and treatment pathway. By combining genetics, hormonal markers and a patient’s disease history, we aim to identify which specific hormone pathology is contributing to her disease and suggest or offer treatment options that fit that biology. Many of those treatments already exist and are used elsewhere in medicine, yet they are rarely used in autoimmunity because no one has built the precision layer needed to select the right patient, guide the choice and monitor the response.

The co-founding Chief Scientific Officer is already in place: a neuroscientist and clinician with 20 years in pharma, four drug launches, medical evidence leadership and deep expertise across immunology, endocrinology and machine learning. She has already taken a diagnostic model from idea to validated proof of concept in an adjacent field. 

The scientific foundation, first product directions and the bones of the business plan are in place; we are now looking for a co-founding CEO to help decide the path forward and build the company around it.

The role

This is a build-first commercial leadership role. You will lead business operations, fundraising, commercialization and the company infrastructure needed to bring the science to market.

You and the scientific founder will make the major strategic decisions together. You will lead the commercial and operational execution of those decisions.

  • Capital: You will lead fundraising from pre-seed through Series A, including investor strategy, outreach, materials, diligence, negotiation and close 

  • Commercial: You will work with the scientific founder to decide which product, market and route should come first, then build and execute the commercial plan 

  • Company building: You will establish the legal, financial and operating structure and turn the existing business plan into a funded operating roadmap 

  • Team: You will define and hire the first commercial and operating team as the company grows 

  • Partnerships: You will lead relationships with investors, pharmacies, pharma companies and other commercial partners 

  • External presence: You will represent the company alongside the scientific founder with investors, clinical partners, industry partners and regulators 

Who we are looking for

We hire on demonstrated capability rather than years served. We are looking for someone who has built something real and knows how to move an early-stage company forward.

This is a full-time founding role. We will consider candidates who begin at a minimum of 50% while transitioning, with the expectation that they become full-time when the first round closes.

  • You have built an early-stage company or major new business line as a founder, CEO or senior operating leader 

  • You have personally led a fundraising process from pitch through diligence and close 

  • You can turn complex science into a clear commercial case 

  • You understand how regulated healthcare companies reach patients, clinicians and payers 

  • You can evaluate several credible routes, make decisions and adjust as the evidence develops 

  • You work well with a scientific cofounder and are comfortable sharing major strategic decisions 

  • You have a good sense of humor, are tenacious and bring a roll-up-your-sleeves, can-do, scrappy attitude 

Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, DTC health or biotech commercialization is strongly preferred. Experience operating in the US market and building for clinicians and payers would also be valuable.

Compensation

Equity: 20-30% founding equity, with four-year vesting and a one-year cliff

Salary: No salary until the first round closes. Founder-level salary begins after the round

Acceleration: Standard double-trigger acceleration following a change of control

Ownership: The founders will hold the majority of the cap table. Daya Ventures will hold a minority venture-studio stake

Application process

Instead of a CV, please share your LinkedIn profile and answer two questions:

  1. 1. Why are you specifically interested in this startup? 

  2. 2. Which strategic assumption would you examine first? 

The process includes two conversations, a meeting with the co-founding CSO, one working session based on a commercial and fundraising case, and two reference calls.

The expected timeline is four to six weeks.

About Daya Ventures

The startup is being built with Daya Ventures, a global venture studio focused on women’s health and other underfunded areas of healthcare.

Daya works hands-on across company creation, fundraising, commercial strategy, brand, product, recruitment and operational execution. The studio combines venture-building experience with deep healthcare context and works closely with founders, researchers, clinicians and industry partners.

Daya’s work is grounded in a simple belief: representation gaps in healthcare create major clinical and commercial consequences. The companies it builds are designed to address those gaps at scale.

To learn more about Daya and becoming a Daya founder. 

Final note

The role of hormones in autoimmunity has been visible in the research literature for decades. Clinical practice still lacks a way to identify the relevant hormone pathology in an individual patient and use that information to guide treatment.

The scientific foundation, preliminary algorithm, first product options and business-plan framework are already in place. The next stage is to choose the first commercial route, raise the capital and build the company around it.

That is the work of this role.

Apply by 4 September. For questions, contact jenny@daya.se.

co-founding-cto-portfolio-startup-clinic.jlDesc:
EU/UK | 15-20% founding equity | Founder-level salary post-angel round

We are building a stealth-stage clinical SaaS startup at the intersection of women's health and precision medicine - and we have identified one of the most consequential and structurally overlooked gaps in modern treatment: medication dosing was designed around male physiology and applied universally to everyone.

The problem is structural, not incremental. It sits in private outpatient psychiatry - a space where the clinical pain is acute, the buyer is accessible, and the infrastructure to fix it does not yet exist. Medication follow-ups run on memory, not data. Every appointment begins with reconstruction. We are building the infrastructure that changes that.

If that is enough to make you curious, read on.

Where we stand

  • Founding team in place. CEO is an MD and digital-health product leader (ex-Flo, ex-Babylon); CCO has built go-to-market and revenue operations in regulated markets. Advised by a CSO who is one of Europe's leading experts in women's psychiatry and sex differences in medicine. All women with a vested interest in this problem space. 

  • A real clinical dataset. A clinical partner with a large longitudinal psychiatric dataset is in advanced discussions; formal agreement in preparation.

  • Commercial pull is real. ICP defined, initial segment identified, and active pilot discussions underway across several EU clinics.

  • Product thesis validated through deep domain research and structured customer discovery.

  • Prototype built. Clinical and UX roundtables underway; MVP build starts July.

  • Academic and research partnerships with leading UK and European institutions being established, including a grant application in preparation with a research partner.

  • Backed by Daya Ventures, the studio that originated the venture and is anchoring the pre-seed round:  hands-on across fundraising, commercial strategy, product development and operations.

The foundation is in place and the co-founding team is exceptionally strong.  We are now seeking a co-founding CTO to complete the team and own the build from here.

The role

This is a build-first technical leadership role. You will join an operating startup and take full ownership of the technical architecture, product execution, and the data infrastructure that determines the startup's long-term position in the market. The product direction is being validated. The technical decisions: stack, architecture, how to build for clinical workflow adoption at scale are yours to own.

  • Architecture: Define and build the technical foundation from the ground up - a secure system design, data infrastructure, APIs, and the scalability path from a workflow tool to a regulated data infrastructure business.

  • Product: Own the build from MVP through the staged product roadmap. The entry product is simple and fast to market by design. The data infrastructure you build today is what makes the long-term vision possible.

  • Compliance: Navigate health data regulation from the ground up. The entry product stays deliberately outside SaMD classification: a strategic choice that keeps time to market short while you design for the regulated pathway ahead. You will work closely with a regulatory advisor.

  • Team: Define and build the team as the startup scales.

  • External presence: Be the technical voice with clinic partners, researchers, regulators, and investors.

Who we're looking for

We hire on demonstrated capability, not years served. We're looking for a true builder. You don't need to have everything figured out. What matters is genuine conviction in the mission and the ability to execute. 

This is a full-time founding role. We'll consider candidates who start at a minimum of 50% while transitioning, but you'll need to be full-time by the time the first round closes. We are not a fit for those seeking a salaried executive role.

  • You've taken a product from zero to something real: as a founder, CTO, first engineer, or full-stack developer at an early-stage startup or project.

  • You've designed and run data infrastructure in production: the specific stack matters less than knowing how to go from prototype to scale.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and own decisions with conviction.

  • You know what GDPR means in practice - and are familiar with health data or regulated software.

Strongly preferred: Experience in clinical SaaS, digital health, or medtech; understanding of what it means to build for clinical workflow adoption, not just technical functionality.

Compensation

  • Equity: 15-20% founding, four-year vest with one-year cliff

  • Salary: None until the first round closes. Founder-level cash post-close

  • Acceleration: Standard double-trigger acceleration on change of control

  • Upside: Founder-tier ownership in a company with a stated path to Series A inside 24 months

  • Ownership: Founders hold the majority of the cap table. Daya, as a venture studio, holds a minority studio stake. Technical architecture and product decisions are the CTO's to own.

Application process

Instead of a CV, please share your LinkedIn profile and answer these two questions:

  1. 1. Why are you specifically interested in this startup?

  2. 2. What strategic question would you challenge based on the role description?

The process includes: Two conversations; Meeting the founding team; One working session around a technical challenge; Two reference calls. Expected timeline: 4-6 weeks.

About Daya Ventures

The startup is being built together with Daya, a global venture studio focused on women's health and underfunded areas of healthcare. Daya works hands-on across company creation, fundraising, commercial strategy, brand, product, and operational execution. The studio combines venture-building with deep healthcare context, working closely with founders, researchers, clinicians, and industry stakeholders to build companies capable of reshaping systems - not just participating in them.

At the core of Daya's approach is a simple belief: representation gaps in healthcare are not niche problems. They are infrastructure failures with massive clinical and commercial consequences. The startups built through Daya exist to help close those gaps at scale.

To learn more about Daya and becoming a Daya founder.

Final note

Medication dosing was largely designed without women. The datasets, the trial populations, the titration protocols - all built around a physiology that does not change across the month the way female biology does. We are building the startup that fixes that.

The foundation is in place. Academic partnerships are being set up. A clinical partner with a large longitudinal dataset is in advanced discussions. The product direction is being validated. What remains is the build: shipping the MVP, landing the first clinical pilots, and laying the data infrastructure that makes everything that follows possible.

What comes next is yours to build.

Apply by 26 July. For any questions, reach out to jenny@daya.se.

We're building the harmonisation layer in between - turning scattered, unstandardised women's health data into indication-ready datasets, with bias-corrected representation and pharma-ready packaging for R&D workflows. Built on a privacy-first foundation, every dataset includes a documented legal basis for research use, clear data lineage, and GDPR-aligned governance.

co-founding-cmo-portfolio-startup-matern.jlDesc:
Sweden/EU/UK

25–30% founding equity | Founder-level salary post-seed

We are building a maternal health startup focused on one of the most common and least addressed consequences of childbirth: vaginal tearing. Vaginal tearing affects up to 90% of first-time mothers. Perineal massage is a clinically validated way to reduce that risk - but consistent adoption remains low. The physical, psychological, and usability barriers are still getting in the way.

Our first product is a physical tool designed for self-administered perineal massage - enabling independent, consistent practice without partner involvement.

The category is validated. The opportunity is execution. 

Where we stand

  • Sweden-incorporated

  • Backed by Daya Ventures, a global venture studio with operational involvement in company creation, fundraising, and commercial strategy

  • User research conducted with pregnant and recently pregnant individuals

  • MVP: prototypes developed, tested, and iterated 

  • Full brand identity in place 

  • Regulatory pathway confirmed 

  • Manufacturer relationship in place 

  • Advanced distribution and partnership discussions ongoing

The foundation is in place. An experienced co-founder based in Stockholm, with a track record of taking physical products from concept through manufacturing, compliance, and into market. We are now looking for a co-founding CMO to build a brand that wins - creatively, boldly, unconventionally. Someone to lead the commercial engine through the next phase of growth. That is where you come in.

The role

This is a founding commercial role. Brand, demand, and market entry are not support functions here - they are core to what this startup becomes. You will not be walking into a blank page. What we need now is the commercial half of that equation.

  • Demand validation: Design and run the commercial experiments that prove purchase intent. Build the pre-sales motion, conversion tests, and behavioral signals that give us a real answer.

  • Positioning: Define what the brand stands for and where it plays - birth preparation or broader vaginal health. Translate that into a clear market position through direct market contact.

  • Brand: Build a brand that earns trust in a sensitive, intimate category - where clinician endorsement drives purchase and emotional safety is a prerequisite for conversion.

  • Go-to-market: Define and execute the first commercial channel - direct, clinical referral, or distribution partnership - and generate concrete supply-side interest within the sprint window.

  • Commercial infrastructure: Set up the systems, metrics, and feedback loops that translate sprint learnings into a fundable, scalable commercial story.

Who we're looking for

We hire on demonstrated capability, not years served, and prioritize strong execution and genuine conviction in the mission. We are not a fit for candidates seeking a salaried executive role or those unable to commit at least 50% of their working time. To be a strong candidate, point to specific evidence of each:

  • Senior brand and marketing leadership at an early-stage company: CMO, Head of Brand, or first commercial hire at 0 to scale

  • Experience in retail, DTC, and/or OTC - you know what it takes to get a product on a shelf and off it

  • Experience building brand, community and demand from scratch in B2C or DTC

  • Track record of translating positioning into measurable commercial outcomes - not awareness, but purchase behavior

  • Ability to run fast, lean experiments without a team or budget behind you

Strongly preferred: Background in consumer health, wellness, women's health, or intimate product categories. Familiarity with clinician-influenced purchase journeys. Nordic or EU network in maternal health, midwifery, or consumer health retail.

Compensation

  • Equity: 25-30% founding, four-year vest with one-year cliff

  • Salary: None until the first round closes. Founder-level cash post-close

  • Acceleration: Standard double-trigger acceleration on change of control

  • Upside: Founder-tier ownership in a company with a stated path to Series A inside 24 months

Application

Instead of a CV, answer these four questions:

  • Why are you specifically interested in this startup?

  • What would you prioritize during your first 90 days?

  • Your honest financial runway for an 18-month founder commitment

  • What strategic question or assumption would you challenge based on the role description?

The process includes: Two conversations, One working session on a real commercial challenge; Two reference calls.

Expected timeline: 4–6 weeks.

About Daya Ventures

The startup is being built together with Daya, a global venture studio focused on women's health and underfunded areas of healthcare. Daya works hands-on across company creation, fundraising, commercial strategy, brand, product, and operational execution. The studio combines venture-building with deep healthcare context, working closely with founders, researchers, clinicians, and industry stakeholders to build companies capable of reshaping systems - not just participating in them.

At the core of Daya's approach is a simple belief: representation gaps in healthcare are not niche problems. They are infrastructure failures with massive clinical and commercial consequences. The startups built through Daya exist to help close those gaps at scale.

To learn more about Daya and becoming a Daya founder.

A final note

Up to 90% of first-time mothers experience vaginal tearing during childbirth. A clinically validated way to reduce that risk exists. And yet the tools that enable it are still failing the women who need them most - in design, in usability, and in adoption.

We are building the product that changes that. Not by inventing something new, but by finally getting it right. The foundation is in place. An experienced co-founder is already on the ground in Stockholm. What comes next is commercial execution - and the person who leads it will help determine whether this becomes the category-defining maternal health brand in Europe.

If you are committed to the problem and ready to build a brand that wins, then we want to hear from you.

Apply by 27 May. For questions, reach out to jenny@daya.se.

co-founding-chief-growth-officer-emQ3HU.h2: Co-Founding Chief Growth Officer (Portfolio Startup, Health Data)
co-founding-chief-growth-officer-emQ3HU.jlDesc:
Sweden or Remote (Nordics)
25-30% founding equity | Founder-level salary post-angel round

Women remain significantly underrepresented in the clinical and real-world health data used across drug development, research, diagnostics, and care decisions. The result is a healthcare system built on incomplete datasets - with commercial, clinical, and societal consequences.

This Sweden-incorporated startup is developing a health data marketplace and segmentation layer designed around underrepresented patient populations, starting with women’s health. The platform is intended for pharma, CROs, medtech, and FemTech operators seeking more representative and commercially usable health data.

The initial focus is a high-value therapeutic area within women’s health, with expansion planned across adjacent indications over time.

Where the startup stands

  • Sweden-incorporated

  • A strong network of advisors and clinical experts

  • Backed by Daya Ventures, a global venture studio with operational involvement

  • MVP live (GCP-native ingestion pipeline, BigQuery warehouse, Firebase marketplace)

  • Buyer discovery underway with global pharma stakeholders

  • Therapeutic-area roundtable already initiated

  • Angel round structured and preparing for launch

  • Active grant pipeline across Vinnova, EIC, IHI, Women TechEU, and Gates Foundation pathways

We’re now looking for a co-founding Chief Growth Officer to lead commercial strategy, partnerships, and early revenue generation. You should be able to bring pricing, positioning, pipeline, packaging, procurement, and enterprise trust together into one coherent commercial system as the startup enters its next stage of growth.

The role

This role sits across commercial strategy, enterprise sales, partnerships, and market positioning. You’ll be responsible for turning early market validation into a repeatable commercial engine with strong long-term foundations.

A health data marketplace is not a product problem. It is a commercial-architecture problem. Deals are large (€30K starting, €750K+ at enterprise level). Sales cycles are long. Procurement is dense. In healthcare and life sciences, buyers evaluate far more than product alone - provenance, representation quality, indication precision, compliance documentation, and procurement readiness directly affect whether a contract moves forward or stalls.

Commercial strategy

  • Define positioning, pricing, packaging, and commercial structure

  • Help shape the long-term aggregator vs integrator strategy

  • Build the commercial foundation that supports future scale

Revenue & pipeline

  • Close the first paid contract within 6 months

  • Build and manage a high-conviction enterprise pipeline

  • Establish commercial milestones that support the seed round

Buyer insight

  • Lead structured discovery across pharma, CROs, medical affairs, and data teams

  • Build relationships across the broader healthcare ecosystem

  • Help shape industry conversations around representation and health data quality

Partnerships & external presence

  • Develop strategic partnerships across data suppliers, healthcare institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders

  • Support investor conversations from a commercial perspective

  • post-angel round

We hire on demonstrated capability, not years served, and prioritize strong execution and genuine conviction in the mission.   • Full GTM build experience: product marketing, partnerships, and direct enterprise sales, ideally end-to-end at a venture-backed B2B company

  • Enterprise life-sciences depth: pharma, CRO, medtech, hospital systems, or specialty data vendors

  • Closed contracts at scale: Experience closing enterprise contracts with regulated buyers, ideally in the 6-figure range

  • Data product fluency: the difference between selling a dataset, an API, and an insight

Strongly preferred: prior founder, founding GM, or first-commercial-hire experience; European pharma data and innovation network; working GDPR and health-data compliance knowledge.

Compensation

  • Equity: 25-30% founding, four-year vest with one-year cliff

Application process

The startup is being built together with Daya, a global venture studio focused on women’s health and underfunded areas of healthcare. Daya works hands-on across company creation, fundraising, commercial strategy, brand, product, and operational execution. The studio combines venture-building with deep healthcare context, working closely with founders, researchers, clinicians, and industry stakeholders to build companies capable of reshaping systems - not just participating in them.

At the core of Daya’s approach is a simple belief: representation gaps in healthcare are not niche problems. They are infrastructure failures with massive clinical and commercial consequences. The startups built through Daya exist to help close those gaps at scale

To learn more about Daya and becoming a Daya founder.

Final note

Half of the human population is missing from the clinical and real-world health data that drives modern drug development. We are building the startup that fixes that - at the infrastructure layer, where it actually matters.

The startup already has operational foundations in place: an MVP is live, buyer discovery is underway with global pharma stakeholders, and the fundraising structure is in motion. What comes next is commercial execution.

We’re looking for the person who can turn early market validation into long-term commercial traction - and build the growth engine that carries the startup through the next stage.

Apply by May 17. For any questions, reach out to jenny@daya.se.

gtm-and-sales-lead-venture-creation-core.h2: GTM & Sales Lead – Venture Creation (Core Daya Team)
gtm-and-sales-lead-venture-creation-core.jlTitle: GTM & Sales Lead – Venture Creation (Core Daya Team)
gtm-and-sales-lead-venture-creation-core.jlDesc:
Role: Founding-level

Type: Minimum 50% – preferably 100%

Location: Flexible (Europe)

Start Date: September 2025

Compensation: Equity (shares) with a market‑rate salary post‑funding

Application Deadline: 17 August 2025

Daya Ventures is the world’s first femtech venture studio, focused exclusively on closing the gender health gap by building tech-enabled, scalable, and evidence-based startups in women’s health. With hubs in Europe and East Africa and a global expansion roadmap, we operate at the intersection of impact, innovation, and commercial execution.

Role Overview

We are hiring a GTM & Sales Lead to join the Daya core team and lead go-to-market and revenue strategy across multiple early-stage ventures. This is a key domain role in our Venture Creation phase, where you’ll help take new ideas from zero to commercial validation.

You’ll work side-by-side with founding teams to build GTM roadmaps, test channels, secure LOIs or pre-orders, and ensure each startup enters the market with real traction. This is not a theoretical strategy role – you’ll roll up your sleeves and co-own early sales execution.

Key Responsibilities

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution:

  • Define ICP, target segments, buyer personas, and pricing models per venture.

  • Build early distribution strategy: channel testing, funnel design, messaging.

  • Lead and iterate GTM sprints (digital, B2B, pilot-based, or partner-led).

  • Own outreach systems for LOIs, MOUs, and pre-sales across 3–4 startups.

Sales Pipeline & Traction Building:

  • Secure ≥3 qualified LOIs or pilot agreements per startup before acceleration.

  • Build and maintain a sales pipeline with weekly updates and milestone tracking.

  • Join sales calls and demos, and coach founders on sales readiness.

  • Set up and refine sales materials, CRM tools, and lead-gen processes.

Revenue Model Validation:

  • Co-develop business models and monetization strategies in line with market realities.

  • Test hypotheses around willingness-to-pay, payers vs. users, and conversion triggers.

  • Align GTM efforts with overall startup milestone planning (pitch, funding, revenue).

Cross-Functional Co-Building

  • Work in lockstep with Product, Fundraising, Brand, and IP leads.

  • Participate in venture workdays and sprint reviews as GTM lead.

  • Feed traction insights back into product iteration and business model refinement.

Ideal Profile

  • 5+ years in B2B or B2C sales, growth, or GTM roles – startup or agency experience preferred.

  • Proven track record of launching and scaling early go-to-market initiatives (ideally in healthtech, SaaS, or D2C).

  • Comfort with ambiguity and speed; thrives in fast-moving, multi-project environments.

  • Strong storytelling and persuasion skills; able to translate vision into commercial traction.

  • Experience working with healthcare buyers, procurement, or regulated markets is a plus.

Why Join Daya?

  • Co-create ventures tackling critical gaps in women’s health.

  • Join a high-performance, low-ego team with a bias toward execution.

  • Lead the charge on making our startups fundable, investable, and revenue-ready.

  • Help define how FemTech startups break into market – and win.

We're looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, as selection is already ongoing. For any questions, reach out directly to Jenny Lundkvist at jenny@daya.se.

We are hiring a hands-on, impact-driven Product & Tech Lead to join the core Daya team and take charge of product development and prototyping across multiple ventures in our portfolio. This role sits at the heart of our Venture Creation phase – where we move from validated ideas to investable, scalable businesses.

You will co-build startups with founding teams, drive MVP strategy and technical feasibility, and manage our network of development and prototyping partners. You are not just an advisor – you’re a builder and a shaper of companies from day one.

Key Responsibilities

MVP & Prototyping Leadership:

  • Translate problem/solution validation into tangible product specs.

  • Lead TRL 1–3 prototype development: lab-level proof-of-concept to functional MVP.

  • Conduct or coordinate early-stage feasibility studies (including regulatory or clinical validation, where needed).

Product Partner Ecosystem:

  • Manage and expand Daya’s network of prototyping studios, dev shops, UX/UI consultants, and technical advisors.

  • Negotiate and oversee engagements with external product/tech vendors.

  • Build scalable, repeatable systems for venture tech development (e.g., template tech stacks, preferred vendor playbooks).

Team Collaboration & Co-Building:

  • Serve as the Product & Tech lead across 3–4 active ventures simultaneously.

  • Work in lockstep with functional leads across GTM, Brand, Fundraising, Talent, and IP.

  • Join weekly startup workdays as the embedded product/tech force for each core venture.

Ideal Profile

  • 5+ years of product leadership, technical innovation, or startup experience.

  • Strong experience in early-stage product development (especially TRL 1–4 prototyping).

  • Familiarity with regulated or clinical product development is a plus.

  • Passion for de-risking innovation through stakeholder engagement and iterative design.

co-founder-cto-to-glimmer-femtech-ai-sta.h2: Co-founder CTO to Glimmer (Femtech + AI startup)
co-founder-cto-to-glimmer-femtech-ai-sta.jlTitle: Co-founder & CTO at Glimmer, a Daya-made Femtech AI startup
co-founder-cto-to-glimmer-femtech-ai-sta.jlDesc:
Glimmer is a newly founded femtech + AI startup building the world’s first AI companion for maternal mental health: a context-aware chatbot (powered by LLMs fine-tuned on perinatal psychology) delivering bite-size CBT/ACT exercises, personalized coping strategies and expert-validated content to help expectant parents navigate pregnancy and childbirth with more calm and confidence.

Learn more about Glimmer: https://www.glimmerhealth.eu/

To bring this vision to life, we’re looking for a co-founding CTO - someone who’s excited to build something from the ground up and to become Glimmer's technical voice in shaping the future of maternal health!

We're incorporated in Sweden but work remotely and are open to people anywhere within 2 hours of ETC timezone.

The Role
As a co-founder, you'll have a deep impact in shaping the role, the product, and the company. What you’ll focus on (initially):

  • Shape the technical long-term vision for Glimmer as a company and our product

  • Design and define our AI architecture and tech roadmap

  • Lead the development of our MVP

  • Support beta testing and user research loops

  • Explore and suggest pathways for building scalable technology for a global market post-MVP

  • Contribute to product management and value creation for users and stakeholders

About You
We believe you are an entrepreneur, dreamer, and innovator at heart. You want to achieve great things with great people. You see exciting opportunities with AI and want to be at the forefront of the latest technology, but you understand that an artificial world requires nurturing and elevating human elements.

You might be a: 

  • Full-stack developer, ML engineer or data scientist with deep interest in AI, LLM, NLP and/or RAG

  • Builder with a bias toward shipping MVPs and iterating fast

  • Early-stage startup alum familiar with “building while flying”

  • Someone ready to invest time pro-bono for long-term ownership and impact

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with digital health, mental health, or femtech

  • Have a vision for how to humanize AI and build ethical, adaptive technology

  • Can coach and grow a (future) diverse, distributed engineering team

Current status

  • The founding team consists of CEO Linnéa Belding (10+ years of experience building, scaling and leading tech/AI startups) and CCO Nina Larsen (a decade of global experience in go-to-market strategies and digital product development).

  • We have a small development team in place, consisting of brilliant volunteers dedicated to the cause

  • We just finished building our prototype and about to start testing with users (current waitlist of 40+ people)

  • Glimmer has been accepted into an acknowledged incubator/accelerator that will support the next steps of our journey

  • We are planning to raise our first round this fall

Others

  • This is a founding role - not a salaried position (yet).

  • We’re early-stage but already making waves, gearing up for incubators, funding, and rapid growth.

  • Substantial founding equity + long-term impact awaits the right person.

  • Initial time commitment: ~50% during transition period; full-time expected post-funding.

About Daya Ventures

Daya Ventures is a venture studio creating the next generation of high-growth FemTech startups to close the $1T gender health gap.

By working with researchers, clinicians, and industry leaders, Daya validates real needs and builds scalable solutions. With a structured, repeatable model, the studio de-risks early-stage innovation, accelerates time to market, and increases success rates - systematically shaping the future of women’s health.

Learn more about Daya: https://www.daya.se/
